evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native compatible-job presets can reduce repeated cutting-controller parameter entry while material and machine checks remain human.

assumptions: Provisional route with an existing independent production-supervisor review9, excluded from focal baseline91. Do not create that review if absent; map the real control-authorisation process. Ten of40 programming points are repeated compatible parameter entry; thirty remain for job-specific work and review. Existing preset use and controller runtime earn zero new saving.

Pattern/order producer supplies actual pattern version, quantity and fabric constraints; operator verifies machine id, units, material type and applicable stack/settings. Missing or changed conditions require manual programming/checks. No free pattern extraction or automated safety judgement. s5 is a real production-controller load at1 point, not a routine internal save, and receives no saving.
